label: The more-such package with an IN_ACT_1 bearer forces formal possession, checked (inference)
rule: Compose moreSuchOfDistinctCauseGives at the shared act predicate with distinctCauseGivesOfMoreSuch at formal act
meaning: Assume the package. The registered derivation moreSuchOfDistinctCauseGives, applied at the shared act predicate InAct, gives 'more such': every distinct cause of r in x is more r than x. The registered derivation distinctCauseGivesOfMoreSuch, applied at formal act with the formal more-such bearer, turns that into formal possession. The result has no premises: it is the implication itself, valid for every InAct and every reception and limitation relation, and it asserts no member of the package. Its use is diagnostic: with an observed formal possession gap (25b67649), some member of the package fails under every single act reading; which member is not selected by this theorem.
